Frequently asked questions

The things people ask before they download.

CŌR is coming soon for iPhone, with a companion Apple Watch app. This page shows features built into the current app. Download links will appear when access opens.

No. You can answer the setup questions and review suggested targets and a goal timeline before signing in. Sign in when you want to keep and sync your plan.

The core app includes your plan and targets, food search, manual entries, recognized barcode lookup, calorie and macro tracking, workout logging, strength and weight progress, and supported Apple Health connections. CŌR Pro adds select AI-assisted features; the exact offer is shown in the app.

It can refine a food search and show possible matches. Check the product, brand and serving before logging.

No. Photo and text results are estimates. Before a photo analysis, you can add hidden ingredients, choose a portion and leave a note. Review and edit the result before saving it to your day.

CŌR applies its scoring rubric to the ingredient information it has and explains the findings. Nutrition, allergens and processing data are shown separately when available. If AI helps read a label, its confidence alone does not verify that label. A grade is for food comparison, not medical advice.

No. It summarizes available logged nutrition, training, hydration and recovery data against your goals. Missing readings are not treated as measured results. It is a progress signal, not a diagnosis or overall health assessment.

With your permission, CŌR can connect supported Apple Health activity, sleep, body measurements and nutrition data. The companion Watch app can follow a workout, record sets and manage rest.

CŌR asks for permission before sending content you choose to analyze, such as a meal photo, food description or menu image, to an external AI provider. Separate AI controls are available in the app. Manual logging does not require those AI analyses.

The final subscription price and any eligible trial will be shown in the app before you purchase. No launch price is being advertised on this page yet.
